topic: Interior Lighting Sub System (Z-ONE-3.0 Platform) - Door Rear Left Lamp Control Commands
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific command or configuration parameter for controlling the rear left door lamp's color, brightness, and breathing rate.

column_semantics.DoorAmbtLampE_RL: Door Ambient Lamp Enable for Rear Left
column_semantics.内灯SSTS: Interior Lighting Sub System Technical Specification

core_entities.name: DoorRL5LampColorCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command to set the color of the rear left door ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorRL5LampBrtnsCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command to set the brightness level of the rear left door ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorRL5LampBrthngCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command to set the breathing rate of the rear left door ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: LHZCU
core_entities.description: Local High-level Zone Control Unit responsible for processing commands and controlling the lamp.

core_entities.name: LIN
core_entities.description: Local Interconnect Network used for communication between modules.

core_conditions.name: Color Value
core_conditions.description: Range from 0x00 (no request) to 0xFF (various color values).

core_conditions.name: Breathing Rate Code
core_conditions.description: Code values from 0x00 to 0xFF, with specific rates defined for each code.

core_outputs.name: DoorAmbtLampE_RL
core_outputs.description: Enable signal for the rear left door ambient lamp.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the control parameters for the rear left door ambient lamp in the Interior Lighting Sub System, including color, brightness, and breathing rate. It specifies how these parameters are communicated via LIN and processed by the LHZCU, and what the corresponding breathing rates are for different code values.
